{{Quote|&hellip; the development and mass production of droids has proven invaluable to all spacefaring cultures, and made possible great strides in science, engineering, and exploration, benefitting countless millions.|''Of Droids and Men'' by Anton Saar|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''''Of Droids and Men''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by [[Anton Saar]]. It pointed out that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] population of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], capitalized in the work place, were designed to do tasks organics were unable or unwilling to perform.<ref name="RASB" />

An excerpt from this book began the chapter on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al's]] condensed version of ''[[Report on Growth, Organization, Equipment, Activities, and Objectives of the Rebellion]]''.<ref name="RASB" />
